description: Landing page tag forwarding + operator docs (plan tasks 9-10). On page load, read utm_source (+ optional utm_campaign), persist in localStorage, and rewrite each store badge href so the channel is carried to the store (Google Play &referrer=utm_source=<channel>; App Store ct=<channel>) with no visual/copy change and plain URLs when untagged. Document the canonical channel labels and link forms for the operator. INDEPENDENT of FEAT-001/FEAT-002 (static site + markdown only); can be done in parallel conceptually but executes sequentially in the shared worktree.
steps: Task 9: before editing, READ website/index.html and website/app-fallback.html to confirm current badge line numbers. Add a self-invoking forwardChannelTag() to website/script.js (already included by index.html): read utm_source (+ optional utm_campaign) from location.search; if present, persist to localStorage keys mhw_channel (and mhw_campaign); if absent, fall back to the stored value (multi-page visit). If a tag is resolved, rewrite every .store-badge href — Google Play badge (href includes play.google.com) => append `&referrer=` + encodeURIComponent('utm_source='+channel (+'&utm_campaign='+campaign)); App Store badge (href includes apps.apple.com) => append `ct=<channel>` (+ optional pt=), using `?` if the href has no query yet else `&`. No visual/copy change; if no tag anywhere, leave hrefs untouched (organic).

Task 9 (app-fallback): add the SAME forwarding logic inline to app-fallback.html's existing body script (it has no script.js include). Reuse its #store-badges / .store-badge[data-store='ios'|'android'] anchors and run the rewrite BEFORE the platform-hide step so a hidden badge still carries the tag if later shown.

Task 9 (test): add a dependency-free website/tests/forward-tag.test.mjs runnable with `node --test` that loads the index.html (and app-fallback.html) markup as a string, provides a minimal DOM/location harness (or jsdom only if already available), runs forwardChannelTag, and asserts: with ?utm_source=reddit the Google Play hrefs contain referrer=utm_source%3Dreddit and the App Store hrefs contain ct=reddit; with no query the hrefs are unchanged. If a clean dependency-free harness is impractical, instead document the exact manual browser steps (open the file:// page with/without ?utm_source=reddit and inspect hrefs) in the test file as comments and in findings.

Task 9 (deploy — operator step if creds present): cd website && npm run deploy, then re-verify on the live URL https://mentalhealthwallet.productsforgood.co/?utm_source=reddit that badge hrefs carry the tag. If deploy creds unavailable, record as operator step.

Task 10: in docs/outreach-templates.md add a 'Channel tags & links' section listing canonical stable labels (reddit, linkedin, therapist, organic), the primary landing-page link form https://mentalhealthwallet.productsforgood.co/?utm_source=<channel>, and the store-direct forms (Android https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mentalwallet.app&referrer=utm_source%3D<channel>, iOS https://apps.apple.com/app/mental-health-wallet/id6800036822?ct=<channel>). Note labels must stay stable across experiments and organic = no tag.
acceptance_criteria: Loading index.html with ?utm_source=reddit rewrites BOTH the hero and CTA Google Play hrefs to include referrer=utm_source%3Dreddit and both App Store hrefs to include ct=reddit; loading with no param leaves all four hrefs unchanged.
app-fallback.html's #store-badges hrefs are rewritten the same way under ?utm_source=reddit and left plain when untagged.
The tag is persisted (localStorage) so a later same-visit badge tap still forwards it; the rewrite is invisible (no layout/copy change).
docs/outreach-templates.md has a 'Channel tags & links' section listing reddit/linkedin/therapist/organic with the landing-page link form and the store-direct forms.
verification: Open website/index.html directly (file://, no network) with ?utm_source=reddit and assert hero+CTA Google Play hrefs contain referrer=utm_source%3Dreddit and App Store hrefs contain ct=reddit; reload with no query and assert hrefs unchanged. Repeat for app-fallback.html #store-badges.
node --test website/tests/forward-tag.test.mjs passes (or the manual steps are documented if a dependency-free harness is impractical).
Live re-check after deploy (operator step if creds available): https://mentalhealthwallet.productsforgood.co/?utm_source=reddit forwards the tag on both badges.
docs/outreach-templates.md renders with the new 'Channel tags & links' section and all four labels + link forms.
findings:
IMPLEMENTED. Confirmed badge locations before editing: index.html hero .store-badges (~L51-58) and CTA .store-badges (~L138-145), both after the App Store then Google Play order; index.html includes script.js. app-fallback.html #store-badges (~L96-103) with data-store ios/android anchors, served by its own inline body <script> (no script.js include).

script.js: added a reusable forwardChannelTag(doc, search, storage) exported on window, plus a self-invoking call inside the existing IIFE. Reads utm_source (+ optional utm_campaign) from location.search, persists to localStorage keys mhw_channel/mhw_campaign, falls back to the stored value when no query (multi-page visit). Rewrites each .store-badge: Google Play (href has play.google.com) gets &referrer=<encodeURIComponent('utm_source='+channel[+'&utm_campaign='+campaign])>; App Store (apps.apple.com) gets ct=<channel>. Uses '?' if the href has no query else '&', and is idempotent (skips if referrer=/ct= already present). Organic (no tag anywhere) leaves hrefs untouched. No visual/copy change.

app-fallback.html: added the SAME algorithm inline at the top of the existing body <script> (step 0), BEFORE the platform-hide step, so a hidden badge still carries the tag if later shown. Hand-synced copy of the script.js logic (noted in a comment).

TEST: website/tests/forward-tag.test.mjs — dependency-free (no jsdom in the project). Loads forwardChannelTag out of script.js via new Function with window/document/localStorage/URLSearchParams stubs, extracts the REAL badge hrefs from index.html and app-fallback.html via regex, drives them through a tiny FakeAnchor/makeDoc/makeStorage DOM shim. 6 tests, all green: index.html 4 badges tagged under ?utm_source=reddit (2 Play referrer=utm_source%3Dreddit, 2 App Store ct=reddit); index.html unchanged with no query; app-fallback 2 badges tagged / unchanged; utm_campaign flows into the Play referrer (utm_source%3Dreddit%26utm_campaign%3Dlaunch); stored tag forwards on a later same-visit page with no query. Also separately verified the app-fallback INLINE script (not just the shared fn) by extracting its body <script> and running it against a stub DOM — produced ...?ct=reddit and ...&referrer=utm_source%3Dreddit. Manual browser steps are documented as comments in the test file.

DOCS: docs/outreach-templates.md gained a 'Channel tags & links' section (placed before ## ASO Notes) — canonical lowercase labels reddit/linkedin/therapist and organic=no-tag, the primary landing-page link form https://mentalhealthwallet.productsforgood.co/?utm_source=<channel> (with optional &utm_campaign=), and the store-direct forms (Android ...&referrer=utm_source%3D<channel>, iOS ...?ct=<channel>), plus a note that labels must stay stable across experiments and %3D is an encoded =.

VERIFICATION LEVEL: static/unit only. `node --test website/tests/forward-tag.test.mjs` passes locally. The file:// browser pass and the live re-check at https://mentalhealthwallet.productsforgood.co/?utm_source=reddit after `cd website && npm run deploy` are OPERATOR STEPS — deploy needs Cloudflare wrangler creds not present here; not blocking the branch. Touched only website/script.js, website/app-fallback.html, website/tests/forward-tag.test.mjs, docs/outreach-templates.md (plus this JSON). No app src/, app.json, ios/, android/ changes.
